punchline: When a baboon troop's most aggressive males died, the rest grew calmer and stayed that way for years.
thirty_sec: In Sapolsky's Forest Troop, the most aggressive males died of tuberculosis after eating tainted meat from a lodge's garbage dump. The troop grew calmer: less bullying, more grooming, lower stress hormones in the subordinates. Males who joined later adopted the same style. It was an accident, not an experiment, so it shows a possibility, not a rule.
